title: AgentStatus
description: Agent status response providing runtime information about the agent, device, and application.

agent.description: Information about the DevFlow agent itself.

name.description: Name of the DevFlow agent implementation.

framework.description: The UI layer the agent is instrumented for (for example 'maui' or 'native').

device.description: Information about the device or emulator/simulator.

platform.description: The non-empty platform identity reported by the agent in its native spelling (for example 'Android', 'iOS', 'MacCatalyst', 'WinUI', 'Linux', 'macOS' or 'Tizen'). This wire field is open to external and future platforms. Clients normalize known spellings to canonical lowercase identifiers only when filtering or selecting platform-specific behavior; they preserve the reported value on the wire. See docs/DevFlow/spec/README.md#platform-identity.

deviceType.description: Whether the target is physical, virtual, or otherwise described by the platform backend.

processId.description: Operating-system process ID of the exact running app instance. Used for process-scoped desktop tooling.

running.description: Whether the application is currently running and responsive.

capabilities.description: Boolean status summary for agent capabilities.

jobs.description: Whether platform background jobs are supported by this agent.

extensions.description: Lightweight marker indicating registered extensions. Allows clients to skip the heavier capabilities fetch when no extensions are present or when cached extension descriptors are still current.

count.description: Number of registered extensions. When 0, clients can skip the capabilities call for extension discovery.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the serialized extensions map from the capabilities response. Clients cache extension metadata keyed by this hash and only re-fetch capabilities when it changes.
